item.title: Kerala Police Signs MoU With Cyble to Use Threat Intelligence in Cybercrime Probes
item.dc:creator: News Desk
item.description: A new Kerala Police MoU will bring threat intelligence into cybercrime investigations in the state. Cyble has signed a three-year agreement covering intelligence support, investigative assistance and capacity building.
item.content:encoded: A new Kerala Police MoU will bring threat intelligence into cybercrime investigations in the state.

item.title: CERT-In Flags High Severity Flaws in Popular VPN Clients Used Across India
item.dc:creator: Security Desk
item.description: The Indian computer emergency response team published an advisory covering high severity vulnerabilities in widely deployed VPN clients, urging users to patch immediately.

item.title: UPI Phishing Scams Surge as Fraudsters Target Small Merchants in Maharashtra
item.dc:creator: News Desk
item.description: Fraudsters are impersonating payment providers to harvest credentials from small merchants, with a rise in reported cases across Maharashtra.
item.content:encoded: Fraudsters are impersonating payment providers.
